title: Main Tenu Phir Milangi
author: Amrita Pritam
who: Amrita Pritam (1919 to 2005) was a poet and novelist who wrote mainly in Punjabi and also in Hindi. She received the Jnanpith Award in 1981. The title means 'I will meet you again'.
why: It is widely reported that she wrote this poem late in her life for the artist Imroz, her companion of several decades. I cannot confirm the exact date, so none is shown.
notice: Notice that the poem makes a promise without knowing how it will be kept. Watch the different forms the speaker imagines returning in. Notice how calm the voice is about something as large as death.
prompts: If you could promise one person that you would find them again, who would it be?
In what small, ordinary form would you want to return to someone's day?
